notes: Standard-deviation outlier-detection pattern for Age (script lines 253-279): PROC MEANS captures mean/std into a one-row summary dataset, then a DATA step uses 'if _n_ = 1 then set <summary>' to broadcast those scalars onto every row and flag/filter values beyond mean +/- 2*std. A 10-row inline sample (including a 150 outlier and a -5 within-bound low value) exercises the detection logic.
